citations.short: Orderly handling, prevention of mix-ups, prevention of contamination
citations.long: Your facilities are not adequate to ensure the prevention of contamination of equipment or product by substances, personnel, or environmental conditions that could reasonably be expected to have an adverse effect on product quality.
Your firm lacks adequate production and process controls to ensure the consistent production of a PET drug that meets the applicable standards of identity, strength, quality and purity.
Laboratory written procedures are not followed to ensure that the lab equipment is routinely calibrated.
You did not take appropriate action to correct any identified problems to prevent recurrence of a nonconforming product or other quality problem.
Your reagents, solutions, and supplies used in your testing procedures are not adequately controlled.
